content: When a CanNm service with an invalid PDU ID is called, the called function shall not be executed and it shall return E_NOT_OK to the calling fun ction if applicable. If development error detection is enabled ( CanNmDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE ) the corresponding error CANNM_E_ INVALID_PDUID shall be reported to DE T.
